issue: पिता कियो मारन परसाया: परसाया is not a word and does not rhyme with दासा; Drik Panchang (the only witness; Bhakti Bharat copies it) has it so.
our reading: पिता कियो मारन परसाया (as the base prints it): the father tried to kill him.
alternatives: पिता कियो मारन परयासा (प्रयास, 'effort', rhyming with दासा)

issue: शिव स्वरूप है शरण तुम्हारी: शिव as 'auspicious, blessed' or as the god Śiva.
our reading: Your refuge is blessing itself (शिवस्वरूप = auspicious in nature).
alternatives: O you whose form is Śiva, (I am in) your refuge.
